concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-009 (CPU‑only execution) has no associated task; no task verifies absence of GPU/CUDA dependencies.
Functional Requirement FR-010 (pipeline must finish ≤ 6 h on 2‑core, 7 GB runner) is not covered by any task that measures or enforces total runtime.
Functional Requirement FR-011 (target dynamic‑range validation) lacks a task; no task checks that conductivity spans ≥ 3 orders of magnitude before training.
Functional Requirement FR-012 (exclude molecules with missing conductivity or invalid descriptors) is not linked to any task; exclusion logic is not explicitly verified.
Success Criterion SC-001 (compare model R² to random‑prediction baseline) has no task that records or reports this baseline comparison.
Success Criterion SC-002 (compare feature‑importance rankings to permutation importance) is not addressed by any task; no verification of robustness to feature shuffling.
Success Criterion SC-003 (confidence‑interval coverage measurement) lacks a concrete task; no artifact is generated to assess CI coverage.
Success Criterion SC-005 (pipeline execution‑time measurement) is not covered; no task records total runtime against the time‑budget.
Plan Phase 0 (Data Acquisition & Validation) lists tasks T011‑T015, but none of these tasks appear in tasks.md; the phase is uncovered.
Plan Phase 1 (Descriptor Computation) defines tasks T016‑T018, yet tasks.md contains no corresponding tasks.
Plan Phase 2 (Preprocessing & Splitting) defines tasks T019‑T021, but they are absent from tasks.md.
Plan Phase 3 (Model Training & Evaluation) defines tasks T022‑T028, none of which are present in tasks.md.
Plan Phase 4 (Reporting) defines tasks T029‑T030, yet tasks.md does not include them.
Plan Phase 8 (Deferred Analysis) lists tasks T061 and T012b, which are missing from tasks.md.
Contract `dataset_schema.yaml` is defined but no task validates or generates an artifact against it.
Contract `input.schema.yaml` is defined yet no task references or validates raw input against this schema.
Contract `model_results_schema.schema.yaml` is defined but no task produces or validates a `model_results.json` file conforming to it.
Data‑model entity `Molecule` is specified, but no task explicitly creates, validates, or documents this entity (e.g., generation of a canonical `molecules` array).
Data‑model entity `Descriptor` is specified, yet no task is tagged to ensure descriptor objects are produced per the schema.
Data‑model entity `ModelResult` is specified, but no task explicitly generates a JSON artifact matching the `ModelResult` definition.
While T046 mentions a quick‑start guide, there is no task that verifies the quick‑start steps produce the full end‑to‑end pipeline without errors.

The plan references contracts (e.g., `analysis_summary_schema.yaml`) that are only validated in T103; however, the plan also expects contracts like `sensitivity_schema.yaml` to be validated, which is not covered by any task besides T103’s generic validation list.
